author: Jillian Pikora
title: Pedestrian Killed Crossing Street Outside Crosswalk In Albany: Police - NewsBreak
text:
By Jillian Pikora ,
3 hours ago
A man was killed after being struck by a vehicle while attempting to cross a busy Albany street Thursday evening, Nov. 5, police announced.
The deadly crash happened near the intersection of Western Avenue and Tryon Street around 5:45 p.m., according to a release issued by the Albany Police Department later that evening.
Officers responding to reports of a pedestrian struck by a vehicle found the man lying in the roadway with serious injuries, police said.
Albany firefighters and emergency medical personnel attempted to save him, but the 78-year-old was pronounced dead at the scene.
Preliminary findings indicate the man was attempting to cross Western Avenue outside of a designated crosswalk when he was struck by an oncoming vehicle, investigators said.
The driver remained at the scene, reported no injuries, and has been cooperating with police.
The victim's identity is being withheld pending notification of his family.
Western Avenue has since reopened to traffic.
The investigation remains active and ongoing, police said.
Loved ones are invited to share information, memories, funeral or fundraiser details, and photos with Daily Voice by emailing jpikora\@dailyvoice.com.
This is a developing story. Check back for updates.
